papers.title: Bridging the Topological Divide: Dual-Branch Graph Distillation with Semantic Priors for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2610.19578v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Graph Collaborative Filtering models have achieved remarkable success in recommendation systems. However, they inherently suffer from a catastrophic representation collapse in strict cold-start scenarios due to the topological isolation of unobserved items. While integrating multi-modal semantic features offers a potential remedy, directly mapping isolated semantic attributes into a globally topology-driven collaborative space frequently precipitates representation degradation and optimization conflicts. To bridge this fundamental structural divide, we propose DualGCN, an innovative Dual-Branch Graph Knowledge Distillation Framework. Operating under a decoupled two-stage training paradigm, DualGCN first constructs a robust collaborative teacher network where item representations are anchored by a topology-smoothed semantic prior, effectively reshaping the latent manifold. Subsequently, a semantic student branch employs a residual mapping
papers.summary: 针对新物品没有交互边、图协同过滤表示失效的问题，DualGCN 先训练带语义锚点的协同教师，再以余弦蒸馏训练语义学生，并在推理时重建向量范数。Books 冷启动 Recall@20 达 0.1007，高于 DeepMusic 的 0.0890；Sports 达 0.1119，高于 DropoutNet 的 0.0926，但 Electronics 低于 DeepMusic，优势并不覆盖全部数据集。
papers.key_insight: 冷启动迁移不仅需要对齐语义方向，还需校准冷、热物品向量的尺度，避免点积排序偏置。社区 UGC 可借鉴标题和类别语义加教师蒸馏的设计，先检验新帖召回，再看个性化排序 nDCG 与 CTR；论文仅报告离线结果，没有线上收益证据。教师与学生分两阶段训练，且尚未核验代码可用性，因此实用性评为 3 分。

score_rationale.business_relevance: 社区新帖冷启动直接相关，但需从商品图迁移至 UGC。
score_rationale.technical_novelty: 语义锚定、解耦蒸馏与动态范数校准构成明确方法。
score_rationale.practicality: 训练超参数明确，但两阶段训练成本高，代码与线上部署未核验。
score_rationale.evidence_quality: 三组真实数据及蒸馏损失、残差消融；Electronics 未胜过全部基线，无线上实验。
score_rationale.timeliness: 2026-10-14 首发，处于指定三天窗口。
